wholePhysicalScope: The named mapped roof envelope, approaching paths and the provincial dimensions establish the plan. The current mapped roof is wider and slightly longer than the 16 by 57 metre documented structure.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the long timber roof, layered gilded gables, entry lattice and freestanding bell tower.
limitations: The roof and 2006 porch describe the standing church. Rear elevations and side windows remain representative estimates.
The detached bell tower is placed approximately from the original view. Individual carved scrolls and leaded-glass motifs are simplified.
The modern grounds, school and interior are outside scope.
